title: Voter Rationale
description: A rationale file for an on-chain voter as either an SPO or DRep

body.title: Rationale Body
body.description: Contains the contents of the rationale

comment.title: Rationale Statement
comment.description: This is an open-ended text field giving the voter the opportunity to describe their decision-making processes.

vote.title: Vote Cast
vote.description: The value of this field should match the on-chain vote

govActionId.title: Governance Action ID
govActionId.description: The bech32 representation of the Governance Proposal to which this rationale applies

internalVote.title: Internal Vote
internalVote.description: For group or consortium voters, this object allows providing context to the group vote

signatories.title: Signatories
signatories.description: An array of expected or allowed authors. If present, the authors field should be cross-referenced to this list

items.title: Signer
items.description: The bech32 ID of a signer of this rationale (drep1..., pool1..., cchot1...)
